rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: This Domain Tools MCP server by Abhishek Deshpande provides AI agents with essential domain analysis capabilities through four core tools: WHOIS lookups with registration details and expiration tracking, DNS record queries supporting all major record types (A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT, CNAME, SOA), DNS health checks that identify configuration issues like missing redundancy or RFC violations, and complete domain analysis combining all three functions. Built with Python using the dnspython and python-whois libraries, it includes intelligent domain parsing that handles URLs, automatic date formatting with expiration calculations, and detailed health scoring that categorizes issues as critical, warnings, or informational. The implementation is valuable for system administrators managing DNS infrastructure, security analysts investigating domains, web developers troubleshooting connectivity issues, and AI assistants that need to automate domain monitoring and validation workflows.
